metadata.title: Relative trisection maps on 4-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We show that for an arbitrary compact orientable smooth $4$--dimensional manifold $M$ with a given open book structure on the boundary $\partial M \neq \emptyset$, which may be disconnected, there exists a generic smooth map of $M$ onto the $2$--disk which gives a relative trisection on $M$ consistent with the given open book structure on $\partial M$. This gives a new proof to the existence of a relative trisection on $M$. In fact, it turns out that every relative trisection can be obtained in this way. As a byproduct, we also show that $M$ always admits a decomposition into a PALF (positive allowable Lefschetz fibration) over the $2$--disk $D^2$ and a fiber bundle over the circle with a sutured compression body fiber, consistent with the given open book structure on $\partial M$ and with the surface bundle structure of the PALF over $\partial D^2$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 任意紧可定向光滑四维流形，非空且可不连通边界上给定open book，均有到二维圆盘的generic光滑映射实现与之相容的相对trisection；每个相对trisection都能这样实现。还得到PALF与以sutured compression body为纤维的圆周丛相容分解。
analysis.breakthrough: 为相对trisection存在性给出新证明，并把任意相对trisection纳入统一映射模型。
analysis.limitations: 要求紧、可定向、光滑四维且边界非空；结论不是封闭四维流形的同一分解，也不意味着全部流形本身是单个PALF。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第18页声明仅为文献搜索使用Microsoft Copilot和Google Gemini 3.8 Flash，作者审查核验了所得引用。严格按solely限定记literature，不推断证明、思想或写作用途；作者核验引用不等于模型承担verification用途。
